label: Copy phase, early-middle recall (outputs 2-4) of long sequences, on inputs f/w/v/k/a/n/j/z/d
explanation: Fires only during the copy phase (never on original tokens or the delimiter), almost only when L is 8 or 9. Most mass falls at recall_idx 2-4 (t = 10-13, 63% at recall_idx 3), with a smaller bump on the last outputs of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 7-8). Input identity matters: it prefers fed-back inputs f, w, v, k (each about 3.5x lift), then a, n, j, z, d. It does not fire on first occurrences. Even inside the favored positions and tokens it fires on only about 25% of steps, so it depends on more context (previous token h/0/2/3 helps a little) that no simple predicate captures. The position-only predicate (L>=8, recall_idx 2-4) gets 0.83 mass recall at 0.10 precision. The strongest activations are at recall_idx 3 of L=9 with input v/w/k/z/n.
